action_items: Minor: Add loading="lazy" to the consultation in /app/frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.jsx line 27 (currently missing). Note: since it's above the fold on About page, this is a spec-adherence item; consider whether lazy is actually desirable there.
critical_code_review_comments: TreatmentModal.jsx uses Radix Dialog which portals to body; querying by data-testid works globally and dialog data-state open/closed is present -> smooth open/close animation classes verified.

Both sticky-mobile-cta (bottom:0.75rem) and floating-contact-toggle (bottom:96px on mobile via bottom-24) coexist without overlap at 390x844 - sticky at y≈776, floating at y≈704 (~72px gap). Safe for the standard mobile viewport but verify on shorter viewports (e.g. iPhone SE 320x568) since safe-area padding is applied to both.

/api/clinic-info still returns whatsapp with leading '+' (as noted in iteration_3) — not blocking but consumers using wa.me/${whatsapp} would build https://wa.me/+919...; frontend uses the CLINIC constant so this is only a concern for external consumers of the API.
AboutPage consultation lacks loading='lazy' — trivial one-line fix to fully satisfy spec.
Newsletter subscribe form in Footer.jsx remains UI-only (mock) — not part of this delta but worth flagging that toast.success runs even though no backend endpoint exists yet.

rca of the issue: AboutPage.jsx line 27 is missing the loading='lazy' attribute. HomePage image tag renders with loading='lazy' correctly. Fix: add loading="lazy" prop to the img tag. Reproduction: navigate to /about and inspect document.images filter by customer-assets.emergentagent.com — img.loading returns 'auto'.
